description: Checks an organisation's AI literacy measures against Article 4 of the EU AI Act and returns prioritised gaps with sources. Deterministic, not legal advice.

hasAiUsePolicy.description: Is there written guidance on which AI tools may be used and for what?

sensitiveUseCases.description: Is AI used for decisions about people (hiring, credit, customers' eligibility) or with sensitive data?

staffUsingAi.description: Approximate number of staff using AI for work

trainingDelivered.description: Have staff who use AI received any AI literacy training or guidance?

trainingRecorded.description: Is that training documented (who, when, what)?

trainingRoleSpecific.description: Is training matched to roles and the AI systems each role uses?

usesAi.description: Does anyone in the organisation use AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Copilot) or AI systems for work?

name: assess_article4_readiness
title: EU AI Act Article 4 (AI literacy) readiness check
